target.reason: The target is a narrow paid framework/product detail page. Current first-party implementation guidance explicitly requires a compact product-specific content adapter and rejects turning the generic product template into a 23-section monolith.

live_dom_state.reason: Exact target raw HTML/CSS/JS could not be materialized in this execution; no byte-level or exact-section-count claim is made.
live_dom_state.invariant: No section count, section ID, DOM class, XPath, form action, asset URL or visual-fidelity property is invented as an observed live fact.

known_product_contract.purpose: Diagnostiquer et cadrer un projet IA/data avant un engagement plus large.

stage.label: Maturité
stage.contents: Accès et cadre juridique des données; qualité des données; data owner; référent métier; compétences IA/data; implication utilisateur final; contexte conformité; environnement de test isolé; supervision après livraison.

stage.label: Impact
stage.contents: Grille pondérée couvrant valeur business, faisabilité technique, qualité des données, adoption utilisateur, effort d’implémentation et risque réglementaire.
stage.boundary: Les poids et seuils constituent une heuristique interne; ils ne sont pas un instrument prédictif validé.

stage.label: Périmètre du cas d’usage
stage.contents: Problème; résultat mesurable; limite du premier incrément; décision assistée ou automatisée et contrôle humain; preuve de succès.

stage.label: Proposition
stage.contents: Contexte/problème; objectif mesurable; approche; données/prérequis; plan/jalons; investissement/valeur; risques/guardrails.

claim_boundaries.prohibited: Guaranteed time saving or conversion uplift

pre_purchase_state.rule: When an active payable price exists, the primary pre-purchase path is checkout, not a direct PDF-download action.
pre_purchase_state.known_defect_to_avoid: A generated-PDF link can redirect to the same paid product page, creating a pre-purchase self-loop.

checkout_form.post_payment: Payment confirmation → entitlement → signed access/download path.

inductive_avatar.role: CTO / Head of AI Platform / Head of Data / AI security or trust decision owner
inductive_avatar.decision_need: Make the intended use, scope, constraints, ownership, evidence and acceptance conditions explicit before committing to a larger delivery.
inductive_avatar.must_haves: Existing-stack fit; explicit acceptance criteria; evidence and ownership; maintainability and transfer.
inductive_avatar.deal_killers: Technology-first recommendation; opaque data or authority; unsupported ROI/security guarantees; unnecessary platform replacement.
inductive_avatar.boundary: Role-first synthesis only. Demographics, budget authority, media habits and objections are not asserted as observed customer facts.
